context.selection_policy: One deterministic context per original parent/site, no outcome-dependent retry or resampling. Same full-tree and complete-interval-SNP rules as training.

prediction_policy: Truth-free inputs. Reassemble all canonical example IDs, seal all five parents before private truth access.
scoring_policy: Native six-class endpoint, original semantic sample/haplotype and canonical position joins, unchanged labels. Per-parent/per-cohort/per-class metrics, equal-parent mean and sample SD over five independent chromosomes. Compare existing unchanged historical CNN/Dense/GST/oldTree predictions on identical support. Keep adaptations disclosed.

resources.prepared_contexts: one-parent RAM only, no full-five persistent tensor cache

launch_gate: Freeze prediction/scoring runtime source refs and pass representative TRAIN equivalence and canonical-ID smoke checks before TEST prediction launch. Root owns launches.
